μεταίρω.g: I change my position, depart, remove

μεταβάλλομαι.d: I change; mid: I change my mind.

μεταβαίνω.g: I leave, depart, remove, pass over
μεταβαίνω.d: I change my place (abode), leave, depart, remove, pass over.

μεταδίδωμι.d: (lit: I offer by way of change, offer so that a change of owner is produced), I share; sometimes merely: I impart, bestow.

μετακαλέομαι.d: mid: I summon to myself, send for.

μετακινέω.d: trans: I move away, dislodge, remove.

μεταλαμβάνω.d: (a) with gen: I take a share (part) of, share in, partake of, (b) with acc: I take after (later) or take instead.

μεταμέλομαι.d: (lit: I change one care or interest for another), I change my mind (generally for the better), repent, regret.

μετανοέω.d: I repent, change my mind, change the inner man (particularly with reference to acceptance of the will of God), repent.

μετασχηματίζω.g: I change the outward appearance, transfigure, adapt
μετασχηματίζω.d: I change the outward appearance (the dress, the form of presentment) of something, transfigure; I adapt.

μετατίθημι.d: (a) I transfer, mid: I go over to another party, desert, (b) I change.

μετοικίζω.d: I transport, cause to migrate, remove.

μετρητής.d: a measure, amphora, about 39.39 liters or 8.75 gallons.

μετριοπαθέω.g: I bear gently with, have compassion

μηδαμῶς.g: by no means, not at all

μηνύω.d: (a) I reveal, make known (in a law court), I lay information, inform, (b) I make known, point out.

μιμνῄσκομαι.d: I remember, call to mind, recall, mention.

μισέω.d: I hate, detest, love less, esteem less.

μισθαποδοσία.d: (lit: repayment of price or payment of price due), reward, due punishment.

μισθόομαι.d: I hire out, mid: I hire, engage.

μισθός.d: (a) pay, wages, salary, (b) reward, recompense, punishment.

μνημονεύω.d: I remember, hold in remembrance, make mention of.

μνηστεύομαι.d: I ask in marriage; pass: I am betrothed.

μνᾶ.d: a mina, a Greek monetary unit equal to 100 drachma.

μοιχάομαι.d: I commit adultery, not only of a married woman but of a married man.

μοιχαλίς.d: (a) an adulteress (that is, a married woman who commits adultery), (b) Hebraistically: extended to those who worship any other than the true God.

μοιχεύω.d: I commit adultery (of a man with a married woman, but also of a married man).

μοιχός.d: an adulterer, that is, a man who is guilty with a married woman.

μολύνω.d: I soil, stain, pollute, defile, lit. and met.

μοσχοποιέω.g: I make a model of a calf
μοσχοποιέω.d: I make an image of a calf.

μουσικός.d: skilled in music; subst: a musician, singer.

μυέομαι.d: I initiate, instruct; pass: I am disciplined, learn (a lesson).

μυκτηρίζω.d: (properly: I turn up the nose as a sign of contempt), I sneer at, disdain.

μυριάς.d: a myriad, group of ten thousand, a ten thousand.

μυστήριον.d: a mystery, secret, of which initiation is necessary; in the NT: the counsels of God, once hidden but now revealed in the Gospel or some fact thereof; the Christian revelation generally; particular truths or details of the Christian revelation.

μυωπάζω.d: I am short-sighted, blink, see dimly.

μωμάομαι.d: I blame, find fault with, slander.

μωραίνω.g: I make foolish, taint, make useless
μωραίνω.d: (a) I make foolish, turn to foolishness, (b) I taint, and thus: I am tasteless, make useless.

μωρός.d: (a) adj: stupid, foolish, (b) noun: a fool.

μόδιος.g: a dry measure, nearly two English gallons

μύριοι.d: ten thousand; also used for a very large number, innumerable.

μώλωψ.d: a bruise, stripe, left on the body by scourging.

μῦθος.d: an idle tale, fable, fanciful story.

νάρδος.d: spikenard, a perfume made originally from a plant growing on the Himalayas.

νέκρωσις.d: (a) putting to death, (b) dead or lifeless condition.

νέφος.d: a cloud; met: a dense crowd, a multitude, great company.

νή.d: of affirmative swearing: by, with acc. of person or thing sworn by.

νήπιος.d: unlearned, unenlightened; noun: an infant, child.

νήφω.d: (lit: I am sober), I am calm (vigilant), circumspect.

νίπτω.d: I wash; mid. I wash my own (hands, etc.).

ναυαγέω.d: (a) I am shipwrecked; so (b) fig: I come to ruin.

ναός.d: a temple, a shrine, that part of the temple where God himself resides.

ναύκληρος.d: a captain (master) of a ship, ship-owner.

νεανίας.d: a young man, youth; a man in his prime (used even of a man of 40).

νεανίσκος.d: a young man, youth, an attendant.

νεκρός.d: (a) adj: dead, lifeless, subject to death, mortal, (b) noun: a dead body, a corpse.

νεκρόω.g: I put to death, render weak
νεκρόω.d: lit. and met: I put to death, make as dead; I render weak, impotent.

νεφρός.g: a kidney as a general emotional center
νεφρός.d: a kidney (as a general emotional center), the reins.

νεόφυτος.d: (lit: newly-planted), newly converted to Christianity, recent convert.

νεύω.d: I nod, make a sign, beckon.

νικάω.d: I conquer, am victorious, overcome, prevail, subdue.

νιπτήρ.d: a basin for washing hands or feet.

νοέω.d: I understand, think, consider, conceive, apprehend; aor. possibly: realize.

νομίζω.d: I practice, hold by custom; I deem, think, consider, suppose.

νομικός.g: about law, one learned in the Law
νομικός.d: (a) adj: connected with law, about law, (b) noun: a lawyer, one learned in the Law, one learned in the Old Testament.

νομοδιδάσκαλος.g: a teacher and interpreter of the Mosaic Law

νομοθετέομαι.d: (a) I ordain, lay down, give the sanction of law to, enact, (b) I base legally, regulate, direct.

νοσέω.d: I am diseased, hence of mental or spiritual disease.

νοσσίον.g: a nestling, the young of birds

νοσφίζομαι.d: I rob; mid: I set apart for myself, appropriate for my own benefit, purloin.

νουμηνία.g: the new moon as a festival
νουμηνία.d: the new moon, first of the month.

νοῦς.d: the mind, the reason, the reasoning faculty, intellect.

νυνί.d: adv. (a) of time: just now, even now; just at hand, immediately, (b) of logical connection: now then, (c) in commands and appeals: at this instant.

νυστάζω.g: I nod in sleep, am drowsy, slumber

νυχθήμερον.d: a night and day, twenty-four hours.

νωθρός.d: blunt, dull, hence spiritually; sluggish, remiss, slack.

νόημα.d: a thought, purpose, design; the mind; the heart, soul, feelings.

νόμος.d: usage, custom, law; in NT: of law in general, plur: of divine laws; of a force or influence impelling to action; of the Mosaic law; meton: of the books which contain the law, the Pentateuch, the Old Testament scriptures in general.

νύμφη.d: (a) a bride, young wife, young woman, (b) a daughter-in-law.

νῦν.d: adv. (a) of time: just now, even now; just at hand, immediately, (b) of logical connection: now then, (c) in commands and appeals: at this instant.

νῶτος.g: the back of men or animals

ξένος.d: alien, new, novel; noun: a guest, stranger, foreigner.

ξέστης.d: a Roman measure, a pitcher or cup of any size.

ξενίζω.g: I entertain a stranger, I startle
ξενίζω.d: (a) I entertain a stranger, (b) I startle, bewilder.

ξηραίνω.d: I dry up, parch, am ripened, wither, waste away.

ξυράομαι.d: I shave, shear, cut off the hair.

ξύλον.g: a staff, cross, anything made of wood
ξύλον.d: anything made of wood, a piece of wood, a club, staff; the trunk of a tree, used to support the cross-bar of a cross in crucifixion.

οἰκία.d: a house, household, dwelling; meton: goods, property, means.

οἰκοδομέω.d: I erect a building, build; fig. of the building up of character: I build up, edify, encourage.

οἰκοδομή.g: the act of building, a building, edification
οἰκοδομή.d: (a) the act of building, (b) a building, (c) met: spiritual advancement, edification.

οἰκονομέω.d: I am a steward, manage a household.

οἰκονομία.d: management of household affairs, stewardship, administration.

οἰκονόμος.d: a household manager, a steward, guardian.

οἰκουμένη.d: (properly: the land that is being inhabited, the land in a state of habitation), the inhabited world, that is, the Roman world, for all outside it was regarded as of no account.

φύραμα.d: a mass or lump, as of bread dough.

φύω.d: I grow, grow up, spring up.

φῶς.d: light, a source of light, radiance.

χάριν.d: for the sake of, by reason of, on account of.

χάρις.d: (a) grace, as a gift or blessing brought to man by Jesus Christ, (b) favor, (c) gratitude, thanks, (d) a favor, kindness.

χάρισμα.d: a gift of grace, an undeserved favor.

χαίρω.d: I rejoice, am glad; also a salutation: Hail.

χαλάω.d: I let down, lower, slacken, loosen.

χαλκεύς.g: a worker in brass or copper
χαλκεύς.d: a worker in brass or copper; a smith.

χαλκηδών.d: chalcedony, a small stone of various colors.

χαλκολίβανον.g: orichalcum, or frankincense of a yellow color
χαλκολίβανον.d: orichalcum, a fine metal, or frankincense of a yellow color.

χαλκός.d: copper, brass, money; a brazen musical instrument.

χαρά.d: joy, gladness, a source of joy.

χαρίζομαι.d: (a) I show favor to, (b) I pardon, forgive, (c) I show kindness.

χαρακτήρ.d: an impression, representation, exact reproduction; a graving-tool.

χειμών.d: a storm, tempest; winter, the rainy season.

χειραγωγός.g: one who leads a helpless person by the hand

χειροποίητος.d: done or made with hands, artificial.

χειροτονέω.d: I elect by show of hands, choose by vote, appoint.

χεῖλος.d: a lip, mouth, shore, edge, brink; meton: language, dialect.

χιλίαρχος.d: a commander of a thousand men, a military tribune.

χιλιάς.d: a thousand, the number one thousand.

χλαμύς.d: a short cloak, worn by military officers and soldiers.

χοῖνιξ.d: a Greek dry measure, equivalent to 1.92 pints.

χράομαι.g: I use, make use of, deal with
χράομαι.d: I use, make use of, deal with, take advantage of.

χρηματίζω.d: (originally: I transact business), (a) act. of God: I warn; pass: I am warned by God (probably in response to an inquiry as to one's duty), (b) (I take a name from my public business, hence) I receive a name, am publicly called.

χρηστεύομαι.d: I am kind (full of service to others), gentle.

χρηστολογία.d: a kind address; in a bad sense: plausible speaking.

χρονίζω.d: I delay, tarry, linger, spend time.

χρονοτριβέω.d: I waste time, spend time, delay.

χρυσίον.d: a piece of gold, golden ornament.

χρυσοῦς.d: golden, made of gold, adorned with gold.

χρυσόλιθος.d: a topaz, a gem with a bright yellow color.

χρυσόπρασος.d: a chrysoprase, gem of a golden-greenish color.

χρυσός.d: gold, anything made of gold, a gold coin.

χρώς.d: the skin, surface of the body.

χρῄζω.d: I need, have need of, want, desire.

χωλός.d: lame, deprived of a foot, limping.

χωρέω.d: (lit: I make room, hence) (a) I have room for, receive, contain, (b) I make room for by departing, go, make progress, turn myself.

χωρίζω.d: (a) I separate, put apart, (b) mid. or pass: I separate myself, depart, withdraw.

χωρίον.g: a place, piece of land, field
χωρίον.d: a place, piece of land, field, property, estate.

χώρα.d: (a) a country or region, (b) the land, as opposed to the sea, (c) the country, distinct from town, (d) plur: fields.

χῶρος.d: the north-west wind, and the quarter of the sky from which it comes.

ψάλλω.d: I sing, sing psalms; earlier: I play on a stringed instrument.

ψαλμός.d: a psalm, song of praise, the Hebrew book of Psalms.

ψευδοδιδάσκαλος.d: a false teacher, teacher of false things.

ψευδομαρτυρέω.d: I testify falsely, bear false witness.

ψευδοπροφήτης.d: a false prophet; one who in God's name teaches what is false.

ψευδώνυμος.d: falsely named, under a false name.

ψεῦδος.d: a lie, falsehood, untruth; false religion.

ψηλαφάω.g: I feel, touch, handle, grope for
ψηλαφάω.d: I feel, touch, handle; I feel after, grope for.

ψυχή.d: (a) the vital breath, breath of life, (b) the human soul, (c) the soul as the seat of affections and will, (d) the self, (e) a human person, an individual.

ψύχομαι.d: I cool, pass: I grow cold.

ψῆφος.d: (a) a pebble, small stone, (b) hence, from their use in voting: a vote.

ἀήρ.d: air, the lower air we breathe.

ἀβαρής.d: not burdensome, bringing no weight or oppression upon.

ἀγάπη.d: love, benevolence, good will, esteem; plur: love-feasts.

ἀγαθοεργέω.d: I work that which is good, perform good deeds.

ἀγαθοποιΐα.g: the doing of that which is good
ἀγαθοποιΐα.d: the doing of that which is good, well-doing.

ἀγαθοποιέω.g: I do that which is good

ἀγαθοποιός.g: a doer of that which is good

ἀγαθωσύνη.d: intrinsic goodness, especially as a personal quality, with stress on the kindly (rather than the righteous) side of goodness.

ἀγαθός.d: intrinsically good, good in nature, good whether it be seen to be so or not, the widest and most colorless of all words with this meaning.

ἀγαλλίασις.d: wild joy, ecstatic delight, exultation, exhilaration.

ἀγαλλιάω.g: I exult, am full of joy

ἀγαπάω.d: I love, wish well to, take pleasure in, long for; denotes the love of reason, esteem.

ἀγαπητός.d: loved, beloved, with two special applications: the Beloved, a title of the Messiah (Christ), as beloved beyond all others by the God who sent Him; of Christians, as beloved by God, Christ, and one another.

ἀγγαρεύω.d: I impress (into my service), send (on an errand).

ἀγενής.d: lit: without family, hence: ignoble, base.

ἀγενεαλόγητος.d: of unrecorded genealogy, whose descent cannot be traced.

ἀγκάλη.d: an arm, especially as bent to receive a burden.

ἀγνοέω.g: I do not know, am ignorant of
ἀγνοέω.d: I do not know, am ignorant of (a person, thing, or fact), sometimes with the idea of willful ignorance.

ἀγνόημα.d: an offence committed through ignorance, an error due to (willful or culpable) ignorance.

ἀγορά.d: market-place, forum, public place of assembly.

ἀγοραῖος.d: a lounger in the market-place, perhaps with the idea of agitator.

ἀγράμματος.d: unlettered, illiterate, uneducated, perhaps with the narrower idea: unacquainted with Rabbinic teaching.

ἀγραυλέω.g: I spend the night in the open
ἀγραυλέω.d: I spend the night in the open, bivouac.

ἀγρυπνέω.d: I am not asleep, am awake; especially: I am watchful, careful.

ἀγρυπνία.d: the state of being awake (at night), sleeplessness, watching.

ἀγρός.d: a field, especially as bearing a crop; the country, lands, property in land, a country estate.

ἀγωγή.d: a leading, guiding; hence: mode of life, conduct.

ἀγωνία.d: (properly the feeling of the athlete before a contest), great fear, terror, of death; anxiety, agony.

ἀγωνίζομαι.d: I am struggling, striving (as in an athletic contest or warfare); I contend, as with an adversary.

ἀγών.d: an (athletic) contest; hence, a struggle (in the soul).

ἀδάπανος.d: without expense, for which nothing has to be paid.

ἀδήλως.d: out of sight, obscurely, inconspicuously, uncertainly, without certain aim.

ἀδίκημα.d: a legal wrong, crime (with which one is charged), misdeed, crime against God, a sin.

ἀδελφή.d: a sister, a woman (fellow-)member of a church, a Christian woman.

ἀδελφός.d: a brother, member of the same religious community, especially a fellow-Christian.

ἀδελφότης.d: brotherhood (in the collective sense), the members of the Christian Church, Christendom.

ἀδηλότης.d: the quality of being unseen (of disappearing), indefiniteness, uncertainty.

ἀδημονέω.d: I feel fear, lack courage, am distressed, troubled.

ἀδικέω.d: I act unjustly towards, injure, harm.

ἀδυνατέω.d: to be impossible; I am unable.

ἀδόκιμος.d: failing to pass the test, unapproved, counterfeit.

ἀδύνατος.d: of persons: incapable; of things: impossible; either the inability, or that which is impossible.

ἀεί.d: always, unceasingly, perpetually; on every occasion.

ἀθετέω.d: I annul, make of no effect, set aside, ignore, slight; I break faith with.

ἀθλέω.d: I engage, compete, in an (athletic) contest.

ἀθυμέω.d: I lose heart, am despondent, am disheartened.

ἀκαίρως.d: unseasonably, out of due season, inopportunely.

ἀκαιρέομαι.g: I am without a suitable opportunity

ἀκατάγνωστος.d: not open to just rebuke; irreprehensible.

ἀκατάλυτος.g: indissoluble, that cannot be broken up

ἀκατάπαυστος.d: not ceasing from, not abandoning (giving up).

ἀκατάστατος.d: unsettled, unstable (though these are hardly strong enough equivalents), almost anarchic.

ἀκαταστασία.d: disturbance, upheaval, revolution, almost anarchy, first in the political, and thence in the moral sphere.

ἀκμάζω.d: I reach maturity, become ripe, am in full vigor.

ἀκοή.d: hearing, faculty of hearing, ear; report, rumor.

ἀκούω.d: I hear, listen, comprehend by hearing; pass: is heard, reported.

ἀκρίβεια.d: strictness, accuracy, exactness, attention to detail, scrupulousness.

ἀκρασία.d: incontinence, intemperance (in wide sense), lack of restraint.

ἀκρατής.d: lacking self-control, powerless, inclined to excess.

ἀκριβόω.d: I learn carefully, inquire with exactness.

ἀκροατήριον.d: auditorium, recitation hall, court room (for hearing cases).

ἀκροατής.g: a hearer of, a listener to

ἀκροβυστία.d: (a technical word of Jewish use) foreskin, prepuce: used sometimes as a slang term by Jews, of Gentiles.

ἀκρογωνιαῖος.d: in the corner (of a building); subst: corner-(stone).

ἀκροθίνιον.d: (lit: top of a heap), first-fruits, spoil, treasure (taken in war).

ἀκυρόω.g: I annul, make of no effect, cancel

ἀκωλύτως.d: (characteristic of legal documents), without hindrance, freely.

ἀλάβαστρον.d: a phial or bottle of perfumed ointment, usually of alabaster.

ἀλήθεια.d: truth, but not merely truth as spoken; truth of idea, reality, sincerity, truth in the moral sphere, divine truth revealed to man, straightforwardness.

ἀλίσγημα.d: pollution, perhaps a polluted thing (especially of food).

ἀλαζονεία.d: boasting, show, arrogant display, ostentation; plur: occasions of ostentation.

ἀλαζών.d: a boaster, one who gives one's self airs in a loud and flaunting way.

ἀλαλάζω.g: I cry aloud, a clanging or clashing cymbal
ἀλαλάζω.d: I cry aloud, raise a war-cry; a clanging or clashing cymbal.

ἀλείφω.d: I anoint: festivally, in homage, medicinally, or in anointing the dead.

ἀλεκτοροφωνία.d: the cockcrow, as a period of time, between midnight and 3 a.m.

ἀληθής.d: unconcealed, true, true in fact, worthy of credit, truthful.

ἀληθεύω.g: I say, speak truth, I do truth
ἀληθεύω.d: I say (speak) truth, do truth, maintain truth (the truth).

ἀληθινός.d: true (lit: made of truth), real, genuine.

ἀλλαχόθεν.g: from another quarter, by another way
ἀλλαχόθεν.d: from another place, by another way.

ἀλλότριος.d: belonging to another person, belonging to others, foreign, strange.

ἀλλόφυλος.d: foreign, of another tribe or race.

ἀλόη.d: aloes, the powdered fragrant aloe wood.

ἀλώπηξ.d: a fox; a fox-like, crafty person.

ἀμέθυστος.d: amethyst (a kind of rock crystal: the best specimens are the color of unmixed wine, whence perhaps the name), believed to stave off drunkenness.

ἀμέριμνος.d: free from anxiety (though anxiety is rather too strong a word) or care.

ἀμήν.g: verily, truly, amen, so let it be
ἀμήν.d: verily, truly, amen; at the end of sentences may be paraphrased by: So let it be.

ἀμήτωρ.g: whose mother's name is not recorded or known
ἀμήτωρ.d: (lit: motherless), whose mother's name is not recorded (or known).

ἀμελέω.d: I neglect, am careless of, disregard.

ἀμεταμέλητος.d: not to be repented of, about which no change of mind can take place, not affected by change of mind.

ἀμνός.d: a lamb (as a type of innocence, and with sacrificial connotation).

ἀμοιβή.d: a change, an exchange; hence plur: reciprocal good deeds (services), a fitting requital.

ἀμφίβληστρον.d: prop: something thrown around; a fishing-net, drag-net.

ἀμύνομαι.d: I ward off, defend myself against, resist, defend, assist.

ἀνά.g: and, apiece, by, each, every, in, through
ἀνά.d: prep. Rare in NT; prop: upwards, up; among, between; in turn; apiece, by; as a prefix: up, to, anew, back.

ἀνάγκη.d: necessity, constraint, compulsion; there is need to; force, violence.

ἀνάγνωσις.d: recognition, reading; public reading (of the law and prophets in synagogue or church).

ἀνάγω.g: I lead up, put to sea, set sail
ἀνάγω.d: I lead up, bring up, offer, produce, put to sea, set sail.

ἀνάδειξις.d: the proclamation of an appointment (to an office); perhaps rather admission to membership of a society.

ἀνάθεμα.d: a votive offering, a thing devoted to God; a curse, the thing cursed.

ἀνάκειμαι.g: I recline, especially at a dinner-table

ἀνάλυσις.d: a loosing, departing, departure (from this life); (Probably a metaphor from the yoking and unyoking of transport animals).

ἀνάπτω.d: I kindle, set on fire, light.

ἀνάχυσις.d: outpouring, excess, overflow, a pouring out.

ἀνέρχομαι.d: I come up, go up, ascend.

ἀνέχομαι.d: I endure, bear with, have patience with, suffer, admit, persist.

ἀνήρ.g: a male human being, a man
ἀνήρ.d: a male human being; a man, husband.

ἀνίημι.g: I let go, loosen, release, give up, neglect
ἀνίημι.d: I send up, produce, send back; I let go; I relax, loosen, hence met: I give up, desist from.

ἀνίστημι.g: I raise up, set up, rise from
ἀνίστημι.d: I raise up, set up; I rise from among (the) dead; I arise, appear.

ἀναίρεσις.d: taking away (of life), killing, slaying, murder.

ἀναβάλλομαι.d: I postpone, defer, especially: I postpone the trial of.

ἀναβαίνω.d: I go up, mount, ascend; of things: I rise, spring up, come up.

ἀναβαθμός.g: a step, a flight of steps
ἀναβαθμός.d: a step, a flight of steps; the well-known "stairs" leading up from the temple to the tower of Antonia at Jerusalem.

ἀναβιβάζω.d: I draw up, as a net to shore.

ἀναβλέπω.g: I look up, recover my sight

ἀναβοάω.g: I shout upwards, cry out, raise my voice

ἀναγγέλλω.d: I bring back word, report; I announce, declare.

ἀναγεννάω.g: I beget again, beget into a new life

ἀναγινώσκω.d: I read, know again, know certainly, recognize, discern.

ἀναγκαστῶς.d: by way of compulsion, unwillingly, by force, necessarily.

ἀναγνωρίζομαι.g: I make known to again, make to be recognized
ἀναγνωρίζομαι.d: I recognize; pass: I am made known, cause myself to be recognized.

ἀναδέχομαι.d: I welcome, receive kindly; I undertake, assume the responsibility of.

ἀναδίδωμι.g: I send up, deliver, hand over
ἀναδίδωμι.d: I send up, deliver, hand over, yield.

ἀναδείκνυμι.g: I show forth, show clearly, proclaim, appoint
ἀναδείκνυμι.d: I show forth, show clearly; hence: I proclaim (a person's appointment to an office), appoint.

ἀναζάω.g: I come to life again, revive
ἀναζάω.d: I come to life again, revive, regain life.

ἀναζητέω.d: I seek out, search for (implying the difficulty of the task).

ἀναζωπυρέω.g: I stir up the fire, fan the flame of

ἀναζώννυμι.d: I gird up, brace up (with a view to active exertion); a metaphor from the girding of the flowing tunic, to prevent its hampering one in active work.

ἀναθάλλω.d: I thrive or flourish again, revive.

ἀναθεματίζω.d: I curse, invoke curses, devote to destruction.

ἀναθεωρέω.d: I look at attentively, gaze at, consider.

ἀναιρέω.d: I take up, take away the life of, make an end of, murder.

ἀνακάμπτω.d: I bend or turn back; I return.

ἀνακαίνωσις.d: renewing; a renewal or change of heart and life.

ἀνακαινίζω.d: I make fresh again, renew, restore.

ἀνακεφαλαιόω.g: I sum up, summarize, recapitulate, gather up in one

ἀνακλίνω.g: I make to recline, I recline at a table
ἀνακλίνω.d: I lay upon, lean against, lay down, make to recline; pass: I lie back, recline.

ἀνακρίνω.d: I examine, inquire into, investigate, question.

ἀνακύπτω.d: I raise myself, look up, am elated.

ἀναλαμβάνω.d: I take up, raise; I pick up, take on board; I carry off, lead away.

ἀναλύω.d: I unloose, unloose for departure, depart, return.

ἀναμένω.d: I await (one whose coming is expected).

ἀναμιμνῄσκω.d: I remind, admonish, am reminded, remind myself; pass: I remember, recall.

ἀνανήφω.g: I become sober again, recover sound sense

ἀνανεόω.d: I renew; mid: I renew myself, am renewed.

ἀναντίρρητος.d: indisputable, undeniable, not to be contradicted.

ἀναπέμπω.g: I send up to a higher tribunal, I send back
ἀναπέμπω.d: I send up (to a higher tribunal), send back.

ἀναπίπτω.g: I lie down, recline, fall back upon
ἀναπίπτω.d: I lie down, recline (at a dinner-table), fall back upon (the breast of another person reclining at dinner).

ἀναπαύω.g: I make to rest, give rest to, rest, take my ease
ἀναπαύω.d: I make to rest, give rest to; mid. and pass: I rest, take my ease.

ἀναπείθω.g: I urge by evil persuasion, I tempt

ἀναπληρόω.g: I fill up, make up, fulfill
ἀναπληρόω.d: I fill up, make up, complete the measure of, fulfill, carry out the commands (provisions, etc.) of.

ἀναρίθμητος.d: uncountable, innumerable, that cannot be numbered.

ἀνασείω.g: I shake up, stir up, excite

ἀνασκευάζω.d: I pervert, subvert, dismantle, unsettle, overthrow, destroy.

ἀνασπάω.d: I drag up, pull up, draw up, draw out.

ἀναστατόω.g: I turn upside down, upset, unsettle
ἀναστατόω.d: (perhaps a political metaphor), I turn upside down, upset, unsettle.

ἀναστρέφω.g: I overturn, turn upside down, return, mid. and pass: I conduct myself, live
ἀναστρέφω.d: I overturn; I turn back, return; I turn hither and thither; pass: I turn myself about; I sojourn, dwell; I conduct myself, behave, live.

ἀναστροφή.d: dealing with other men, conduct, life, behavior, manner of life.

ἀνατάσσομαι.d: I arrange, draw up, compose, but perhaps: I set down from memory, restore from memory.

ἀνατέλλω.g: I make to rise, I rise, shine
ἀνατέλλω.d: I make to rise, I rise, shine (generally of the sun, and hence met.).

ἀνατολή.g: rising of the sun, the East
ἀνατολή.d: (a) rising of the sun, hence (b) (sing. and plur.) the quarter whence the sun rises, the East.

ἀνατρέπω.d: I overturn (lit. or met.), subvert, overthrow, corrupt.

ἀνατρέφω.d: I rear, bring up, nourish, educate.

ἀναφέρω.g: I carry up, lead up, offer up
ἀναφέρω.d: (a) I carry up, lead up, (b) I offer up (on a high altar) as a sacrifice, offer up to God on high.

ἀναφαίνω.d: (a) a nautical term: I sight (a place), (b) mid: I appear (as it were, out of the unseen), (c) I bring to light, make to appear.

ἀναχωρέω.d: I return, retire, withdraw, depart (underlying idea perhaps of taking refuge from danger or of going into retirement).

ἀνδρίζομαι.g: I act like a man, am brave

ἀνδραποδιστής.d: an enslaver, one who forcibly enslaves, a kidnapper.

ἀνεκδιήγητος.g: indescribable, that cannot be thoroughly related
ἀνεκδιήγητος.d: indescribable, that cannot be thoroughly related, inexpressible.

ἀνεμίζομαι.g: I am blown with the wind
ἀνεμίζομαι.d: I am blown with the wind (referring to the gentler motions of the air).

ἀνεξίκακος.d: enduring evil, patient of evil, patiently forbearing.

ἀνεπαίσχυντος.g: having no cause to be ashamed

ἀνετάζω.d: I examine (a person on trial, a witness) judicially (frequently by the aid of torture).

ἀνευρίσκω.d: I find by seeking out, discover.

ἀνεύθετος.d: unfitted, unsuitable, inconvenient, not well placed.

ἀνθίστημι.g: I take a stand against, oppose, resist
ἀνθίστημι.d: I set against; I withstand, resist, oppose.

ἀνθομολογέομαι.d: I make a mutual agreement; I confess, acknowledge, formally admit, give thanks to.

ἀνθρακιά.d: a coal-fire, a heap of burning coals.

ἀνθρωπάρεσκος.d: desirous of pleasing men, a renderer of service to human beings (as opposed to God).

ἀνθρώπινος.d: belonging to human beings (especially as contrasted with God), human (as contrasted with divine).

ἀνοικοδομέω.d: I rebuild, build up (what has fallen or been razed to the ground), sometimes merely: I build.

ἀνορθόω.g: I make straight again, rear again, restore
ἀνορθόω.d: I make upright (straight) again, rear again, restore.

ἀνοχή.d: forbearance, suspense or delay (of punishment), patience.

ἀντέχομαι.d: trans: I hold against; intrans: I withstand; mid: I hold out against, hold firmly to, cleave to.

ἀντί.d: (a) instead of, in return for, over against, opposite, in exchange for, as a substitute for, (b) on my behalf, (c) wherefore, because.

ἀντίθεσις.d: a proposition, tenet, opinion advanced by one party against another; opposition.

ἀντίκειμαι.d: I resist, oppose, withstand, lie opposite to.

ἀντίτυπος.g: typical of, representing by type or pattern
ἀντίτυπος.d: typical of, representing by type (or pattern), corresponding to, an image.

ἀντίχριστος.d: antichrist, either one who puts himself in the place of, or the enemy (opponent) of the Messiah.

ἀνταναπληρόω.g: I fill up in place of someone else
ἀνταναπληρόω.d: I fill up in place of someone else, complete, supply.

ἀνταποκρίνομαι.d: I contradict, reply against, give a hostile answer.

ἀνταπόδομα.g: a gift in return, a return, a recompense
ἀνταπόδομα.d: a gift in return (for another), a return, recompense, requital.

ἀντιβάλλω.g: I throw at in opposition, exchange words with
ἀντιβάλλω.d: I throw at in opposition, exchange (words) with, perhaps: I compare.

ἀντιλέγω.g: I speak or say in opposition, contradict
ἀντιλέγω.d: I speak or say in opposition, contradict (oppose, resist).

ἀντιλαμβάνομαι.g: I take hold of, help, share in
ἀντιλαμβάνομαι.d: I take hold of, help, share in, partake of, enjoy.

ἀντιλοιδορέω.g: I abuse in return, give abuse for abuse

ἀντιμετρέω.g: I measure in return, give equivalent measure

ἀντιπίπτω.g: I fall foul of, resist, oppose
ἀντιπίπτω.d: I resist, oppose, fall against or upon.

ἀντιπαρέρχομαι.d: I pass opposite, on the opposite side of the road.

ἀντιτάσσομαι.d: I set myself against, resist (the attack of).

ἀντλέω.d: I draw (generally water from a deep well in the ground); perhaps: I draw out.

ἀντοφθαλμέω.d: I face (lit: "I present my eye to"), resist, withstand; as nautical term: I bear up against the wind.

ἀνώτερον.g: higher, to a more honorable place, previously, above
ἀνώτερον.d: higher, to a more honorable place (at the dinner table); previously, in an earlier passage (or a book), above.

ἀξίως.g: worthily, in a manner worthy of

ἀξιόω.g: I account or treat as worthy

ἀπάγχομαι.d: I choke, strangle; mid: I strangle or hang myself.

ἀπάγω.d: I lead, carry, take away; met: I am led astray, seduced.

ἀπάντησις.g: the act of meeting, to meet
ἀπάντησις.d: the act of meeting, to meet (a phrase seemingly almost technical for the reception of a newly arrived official).

ἀπέκδυσις.d: a putting off (as of a garment), a casting off.

ἀπέναντι.g: over against, opposite, in view of, in the presence of
ἀπέναντι.d: against, over against, opposite, in view of, in the presence of.

ἀπέρχομαι.g: I come or go away from, depart, return
ἀπέρχομαι.d: I come or go away from, depart, return, arrive, go after, follow.

ἀπέχω.g: I have in full, am far, it is enough

ἀπαίδευτος.d: untrained, uneducated, showing a want of training or education, ignorant.

ἀπαίρω.d: I take away, remove; pass: I am taken away, withdrawn.

ἀπαγγέλλω.g: I report, bring a report, announce
ἀπαγγέλλω.d: I report (from one place to another), bring a report, announce, declare.

ἀπαιτέω.g: I ask back, ask what is my due
ἀπαιτέω.d: I ask back, ask what is my due, demand back.

ἀπαλγέω.g: I am past feeling, cease to care, become callous
ἀπαλγέω.d: (lit: I cease to feel [my] pain), am past feeling, cease to care (suggesting sometimes despair, sometimes recklessness), become callous, reckless.

ἀπαλλάσσω.d: I free (a person) from (anything), oftener in the middle voice: I am released from, am rid of (a person or thing), depart.

ἀπαλλοτριόομαι.d: I estrange, alienate; pass: I am alienated from.

ἀπαντάω.d: I go to meet, meet, encounter.

ἀπαρνέομαι.d: I deny, disown, repudiate (either another person or myself), disregard.

ἀπαρχή.d: the first-fruits, the earliest crop of the year, hence also met., for example, of the earliest converts in a district; there is evidence in favor of rendering in some passages merely by: sacrifice, gift.

ἀπατάω.d: I deceive, cheat, lead into error.

ἀπαύγασμα.g: a light flashing forth, radiation, gleam
ἀπαύγασμα.d: a light flashing forth (from), radiation, gleam.

ἀπείραστος.g: untried, inexperienced, incapable of being tempted
ἀπείραστος.d: untried, inexperienced, untempted, incapable of being tempted.

ἀπειθέω.d: I disobey, rebel, am disloyal, refuse conformity.

ἀπειθής.d: unbelieving, disobedient, who will not be persuaded.

ἀπεκδέχομαι.g: I expect eagerly, wait for eagerly
ἀπεκδέχομαι.d: I expect eagerly, wait for eagerly, look for.

ἀπελεύθερος.d: a freedman, one who has been a slave but has been manumitted by his master.

ἀπελπίζω.d: I give up in despair, despair of; I hope to receive from or in return.

ἀπιστέω.d: I am unfaithful, disbelieve, refuse belief, prove false.

ἀποβάλλω.g: I throw away from, throw overboard
ἀποβάλλω.d: I throw away from, throw overboard, cast aside.

ἀποβαίνω.g: I go or come out of, disembark, result
ἀποβαίνω.d: I go or come out of, disembark, turn out, result, become, happen.

ἀποβλέπω.g: I look away from, turn my attention to
ἀποβλέπω.d: I look away from all else at one object, look steadfastly.

ἀποβολή.d: a casting away, rejection, a loss.

ἀπογίνομαι.g: I go out of being, cease to be, die
ἀπογίνομαι.d: I am away, am removed from, depart life, die.

ἀπογράφω.g: I enroll, inscribe in a register
ἀπογράφω.d: I enroll, inscribe in a register; mid: I give my name for registration (or census-taking).

ἀποδέχομαι.d: I receive, welcome, entertain (with hospitality), embrace.

ἀποδίδωμι.d: (a) I give back, return, restore, (b) I give, render, as due, (c) mid: I sell.

ἀποδείκνυμι.g: I show by proof, demonstrate, set forth
ἀποδείκνυμι.d: I show by proof, demonstrate, set forth, proclaim to an officer.

ἀποδεκατόω.g: I take off a tenth part, pay tithe
ἀποδεκατόω.d: I take off (deduct) a tenth part (of my property) (and give it away), pay tithe.

ἀποδημέω.d: I am away from home, go into another country, am away, am abroad.

ἀποδιορίζω.d: I make a logical distinction, make an invidious distinction.

ἀποδοκιμάζω.g: I reject after testing, I disqualify

ἀποδοχή.d: (properly: reception, welcome, of guests), acceptance, appreciation, approbation.

ἀποθλίβω.d: (lit: I rub), jostle, press hard, crowd.

ἀποθνῄσκω.g: I am dying, am about to die
ἀποθνῄσκω.d: I am dying, am about to die, wither, decay.

ἀποκαθίστημι.d: I set up again, restore to its original position or condition; hence: I restore, give back.

ἀποκαλύπτω.g: I uncover, bring to light, reveal

ἀποκαταλλάσσω.d: I reconcile, change from one state of feeling to another.

ἀποκλείω.d: I shut fast, close, shut up.

ἀποκρίνομαι.d: I answer, reply, take up the conversation.

ἀποκρύπτω.d: I hide away, conceal, keep secret.

ἀποκτείνω.d: I put to death, kill; fig: I abolish.

ἀποκυέω.g: I bring forth, give birth to
ἀποκυέω.d: I bring forth, give birth to (a child), a medical or physical word, marking the close of pregnancy.

ἀποκόπτω.d: I smite, cut off, cut loose; mid: I emasculate, castrate, mutilate myself.

ἀπολαμβάνω.d: (a) I get back, receive back, (b) I get (receive) as due (deserved), (c) mid: I draw aside, separate.

ἀπολείπω.g: I leave, leave behind, desert, am reserved
ἀπολείπω.d: I leave, leave behind; pass: I am reserved, remain; I desert, abandon.

ἀπολογέομαι.g: I give a defense, defend myself
ἀπολογέομαι.d: I give a defense, defend myself (especially in a law court): it can take an object of what is said in defense.

ἀπολογία.d: a verbal defense (particularly in a law court).

ἀπολούομαι.d: I wash off, mid: I wash away (my sins, in baptism).

ἀπολύτρωσις.d: release effected by payment of ransom; redemption, deliverance.

ἀπολύω.g: I release, let go, send away, divorce
ἀπολύω.d: I release, let go, send away, divorce, am rid; mid: I depart.

ἀπομάσσομαι.d: I wipe off, wipe clean; mid: I wipe myself off.

ἀποπίπτω.g: I fall away from, fall off

ἀποπλανάω.g: I cause to wander astray, have wandered away
ἀποπλανάω.d: I cause to go astray; pass: I am led astray.

ἀποπνίγω.g: I suffocate, choke, drown, stop the growth of
ἀποπνίγω.d: (a) I suffocate, choke, drown, (b) I stop the growth of.

ἀπορέω.g: I am in difficulties, am at my wits end
ἀπορέω.d: I am at a loss, am perplexed; mid: I am in doubt.

ἀπορφανίζω.g: I separate from some one, bereave
ἀπορφανίζω.d: I separate from some one, am bereaved.

ἀποσκίασμα.g: a shadow, a faint image or copy
ἀποσκίασμα.d: either a shadow cast by an object, or a faint image or copy of an object.

ἀποσπάω.g: I wrench away from, drag away, withdraw
ἀποσπάω.d: lit: I wrench away from, drag away, but perhaps sometimes in the well-attested weakened sense: I am parted or withdrawn.

ἀποστάσιον.d: repudiation, divorce; met: bill of divorce.

ἀποστέλλω.g: I send forth, send, send away, dismiss
ἀποστέλλω.d: I send forth, send (as a messenger, commission, etc.), send away, dismiss.

ἀποστεγάζω.g: I unroof, take the roof off

ἀποστερέω.g: I deprive one of something, rob
ἀποστερέω.d: I defraud, deprive of, despoil; mid: I endure deprivation; pass: I am bereft of.

ἀποστρέφω.d: I turn away, pervert, remove; I restore, replace; mid: I desert, reject.

ἀποσυνάγωγος.d: away from the synagogue, expelled from the synagogue, excommunicated.

ἀποτάσσομαι.g: I withdraw from, take leave of, renounce, send away

ἀποτίθημι.g: I lay off or aside, renounce
ἀποτίθημι.d: I lay off or aside, renounce, stow away, put.

ἀποτίνω.g: I repay, pay what is due
ἀποτίνω.d: I repay, pay what is due (by way of punishment or fine), make good.

ἀποτελέω.g: I complete, accomplish, form fully, perfect
ἀποτελέω.d: I complete, accomplish, form fully, perfect, bring to maturity.

ἀποτομία.d: (lit: sheerness, of a rock), abruptness, harshness, severity, rigor.

ἀποφέρω.d: I carry, bear away (sometimes with violence).

ἀποχωρίζομαι.d: I separate from; mid: I part; pass: I am swept aside.

ἀποψύχω.g: I faint, breathe out life, die
ἀποψύχω.d: I faint, breathe out life, die, am dismayed.

ἀπρόσκοπος.g: not offending, not causing offence, blameless
ἀπρόσκοπος.d: (free from hurt or harm, hence) not offending, not causing offence, blameless.

ἀπωθέομαι.g: I push or thrust away, reject
ἀπωθέομαι.d: I push (thrust) away, repulse, reject, refuse.

ἀπόβλητος.g: worthy to be cast away, worthless
ἀπόβλητος.d: worthy to be cast away, worthless, regarded as vile.

ἀπόδεκτος.g: worthy to be received, acceptable, welcome
ἀπόδεκτος.d: worthy to be received (welcomed), acceptable, welcome, pleasant.

ἀπόδημος.d: away from home, sojourning in another country.

ἀπόθεσις.g: a putting off, a laying down

ἀπόκειμαι.g: I have been put away, am stored, am reserved for

ἀπόλαυσις.g: the faculty or experience of enjoyment

ἀπόλλυμι.d: (a) I kill, destroy, (b) I lose, mid: I am perishing (the resultant death being viewed as certain).

ἀπόστολος.g: an apostle, a messenger, an envoy, a delegate
ἀπόστολος.d: a messenger, envoy, delegate, one commissioned by another to represent him in some way, especially a man sent out by Jesus Christ Himself to preach the Gospel; an apostle.

ἀπώλεια.d: destruction, ruin, loss, perishing; eternal ruin.

ἀρά.g: a prayer or prayer for evil, a curse, imprecation
ἀρά.d: a prayer; more commonly: a prayer for evil, a curse, imprecation.

ἀρέσκω.d: I please, with the idea of willing service rendered to others; hence almost: I serve.

ἀργύριον.g: silver, a shekel, money in general
ἀργύριον.d: silver, a piece of silver, a shekel, money in general.

ἀρετή.d: goodness, a gracious act, virtue, uprightness.

ἀρκέω.g: I am sufficient, I suffice, am content, satisfied
ἀρκέω.d: I keep off, assist; I suffice; pass: I am satisfied.

ἀρνέομαι.d: (a) I deny (a statement), (b) I repudiate (a person, or belief).

ἀρνίον.d: (originally: a little lamb, but diminutive force was lost), a lamb.

ἀρραβών.d: an earnest, earnest-money, a large part of the payment, given in advance as a security that the whole will be paid afterwards.

ἀρσενοκοίτης.g: a male engaging in same-gender sexual activity
ἀρσενοκοίτης.d: a male engaging in same-gender sexual activity; a sodomite, pederast.

ἀρτέμων.g: a foresail, set on the bow

ἀρτύω.d: prop: I arrange, make ready; I season, flavor.

ἀρχάγγελος.g: a ruler of angels, a superior angel, an archangel

ἀρχή.d: (a) rule (kingly or magisterial), (b) plur: in a quasi-personal sense, almost: rulers, magistrates, (c) beginning.

ἀρχιερατικός.g: high priestly, to which the chief priest belongs

ἀρχισυνάγωγος.d: a leader of the synagogue, a leader connected with the synagogue: sometimes there was only one, and the name was in some cases merely honorary.

ἀρχιτελώνης.g: head of a custom-house, chief tax-gatherer
ἀρχιτελώνης.d: head of a custom-house, chief tax-gatherer or publican.

ἀρχιτρίκλινος.d: master of ceremonies at a dinner, master of the feast.

ἀσέλγεια.d: (outrageous conduct, conduct shocking to public decency, a wanton violence), wantonness, lewdness.

ἀσεβέω.g: I am impious, irreverent, do impiously

ἀσθένεια.d: want of strength, weakness, illness, suffering, calamity, frailty.

ἀσθενέω.d: I am weak (physically: then morally), I am sick.

ἀσθενής.d: (lit: not strong), (a) weak (physically, or morally), (b) infirm, sick.

ἀσιτία.d: either: lack or wheat, lack of food (the literal meaning), or: abstinence from food, a fast, loss of appetite, sea-sickness (the extended meaning).

ἀσπάζομαι.g: I greet, salute, pay my respects to
ἀσπάζομαι.d: I greet, salute, pay my respects to, welcome.

ἀσσάριον.d: a small coin equal to the tenth part of a drachma.

ἀστατέω.g: I am unsettled, have no fixed abode
ἀστατέω.d: I am unsettled, have no fixed abode, lead a vagabond life.

ἀστεῖος.d: (lit: belonging to the city; then: witty, clever), elegant, pretty, fair, fine, beautiful.

ἀστοχέω.g: I miss the mark, miss my aim, make a false aim
ἀστοχέω.d: I miss the mark, miss my aim, make a false aim, fail.

ἀστράπτω.d: I flash (with, then like, lightning), am lustrous.

ἀστραπή.g: a flash of lightning, brightness, luster

ἀσφαλής.d: (lit: unfailing), safe, reliable, trustworthy, certain, sure.

ἀσχημονέω.d: I act improperly, am unseemly, behave unbecomingly (or even dishonorably); perhaps: I consider (something) unseemly.

ἀσχημοσύνη.d: unseemly behavior, unseemliness, indecency, shame, nakedness, an indecent (lewd) act.

ἀσύνετος.d: unintelligent, without wisdom, unwise, undiscerning (implying probably moral defect).

ἀσύνθετος.d: not covenanting, untrue to an agreement, treacherous.

ἀτακτέω.d: (lit: I march out of order; then: I riot, rebel), behave disorderly, neglect my duty, am careless (or idle) in habits.

ἀτενίζω.g: I direct my gaze, look steadily

ἀτιμάζω.d: I disgrace, treat disgracefully, dishonor, insult; I despise.

ἀφίημι.g: I send away, release, remit, forgive, permit
ἀφίημι.d: (a) I send away, (b) I let go, release, permit to depart, (c) I remit, forgive, (d) I permit, suffer.

ἀφίσταμαι.g: I lead away, seduce, depart, abstain from
ἀφίσταμαι.d: I make to stand away, draw away, repel, take up a position away from, withdraw from, leave, abstain from.

ἀφανίζω.g: I cause to disappear, I hide, remove, disfigure
ἀφανίζω.d: I cause to disappear, hide, remove; I disfigure (probably by leaving unwashed for a long period), destroy.

ἀφικνέομαι.d: I arrive at, reach, come to.

ἀφιλάγαθος.g: not loving that which is good

ἀφοράω.d: I look away from (something else) to, see distinctly.

ἀφορίζω.g: I rail off, separate, place apart

ἀφορμή.d: (a) a starting, a start, (b) cause, occasion, opportunity.

ἀφροσύνη.d: want of sense, foolishness, impiety, wickedness.

ἀχειροποίητος.g: not made by hand, not handmade

ἀχρειόομαι.d: (lit: I become sour, I turn, of milk), I am good for nothing, render useless; met: I become corrupt.

ἁγιάζω.d: I make holy, treat as holy, set apart as holy, sanctify, hallow, purify.

ἁγιασμός.d: the process of making or becoming holy, set apart, sanctification, holiness, consecration.

ἁγιότης.d: holiness, sanctity, as an abstract quality.

ἁγνίζω.d: I cleanse, purify, either ceremonially, actually, or morally.

ἁγνός.d: (originally, in a condition prepared for worship), pure (either ethically, or ritually, ceremonially), chaste.

ἁγνῶς.d: purely, sincerely, with pure motives, honestly.

ἁλίζω.g: I salt, sprinkle with salt, keep fresh and sound
ἁλίζω.d: I salt, sprinkle with salt (of sacrifices or of those who offer sacrifice), keep fresh and sound, and so acceptable to God.

ἁμαρτάνω.d: originally: I miss the mark, hence (a) I make a mistake, (b) I sin, commit a sin (against God); sometimes the idea of sinning against a fellow-creature is present.

ἁμαρτία.d: prop: missing the mark; hence: (a) guilt, sin, (b) a fault, failure (in an ethical sense), sinful deed.

ἁπαλός.d: soft, tender, as a shoot of a tree.

ἁρμόζομαι.d: I fit, join; mid: (the middle indicating deep personal interest) I espouse, betroth; mid: I take a wife, give in marriage.

ἁρπάζω.g: I seize, snatch, obtain by robbery

ἁρπαγή.g: the act of plundering, plunder, spoil
ἁρπαγή.d: the act of plundering; plunder, spoil, robbery.

ἁρπαγμός.g: spoil, an object of eager desire, a prize

ἁφή.d: a band, fastening (hence, possibly: a ligament), joint.

ἄβυσσος.d: the abyss, unfathomable depth, an especially Jewish conception, the home of the dead and of evil spirits.

ἄγαμος.d: unmarried, of a person not in a state of wedlock, whether he or she has formerly been married or not.

ἄγγελος.d: a messenger, generally a (supernatural) messenger from God, an angel, conveying news or behests from God to men.

ἄγνοια.d: ignorance, inadvertence, sometimes with the idea of willful blindness.

ἄγω.d: I lead, lead away, bring (a person, or animal), guide, spend a day, go.

ἄζυμος.d: unleavened, the paschal feast (a feast of the Hebrews); fig: uncorrupted, sincere.

ἄθεος.d: without god, without (the only true) God, godless.

ἄθλησις.d: a struggling (as in an athletic contest).

ἄκανθα.d: a thorn-bush, prickly plant; a thorn.

ἄκων.d: unwilling, generally used where English would express by an adverb: unwillingly.

ἄλαλος.d: unable to speak or articulate; speechless.

ἄλλος.d: other, another (of more than two), different.

ἄλογος.d: without reason, irrational; contrary to reason, absurd.

ἄμαχος.d: peaceable, abstaining from fighting, not contentious.

ἄμεμπτος.d: blameless, free from fault or defect.

ἄμετρος.d: not measurable, immeasurable, to a limitless degree.

ἄμφοδον.d: prop: a road around anything; the street of a village.

ἄν.g: an untranslatable word that makes a statement contingent
ἄν.d: an untranslatable word (under the circumstances, in that case, anyhow), the general effect of which is to make a statement contingent, which would otherwise be definite: it is thus regularly used with the subjunctive mood.

ἄνεμος.d: the wind; fig: applied to empty doctrines.

ἄνευ.g: without, without the cooperation or knowledge of
ἄνευ.d: without, without the cooperation (or knowledge) of.

ἄνθος.d: bloom, possibly a reference to the bright flowers, such as poppies (among the grass).

ἄνθρωπος.g: a man, one of the human race

ἄντλημα.d: what is drawn; a vessel or bucket to draw with.

ἄνυδρος.d: without water, dry; subst: dry places, desert.

ἄνω.d: up, above, up to the top, up to the brim, things above, heaven, the heavenly region.

ἄνωθεν.g: from above, from the beginning, again
ἄνωθεν.d: (a) from above, from heaven, (b) from the beginning, from their origin (source), from of old, (c) again, anew.

ἄξιος.d: worthy, worthy of, deserving, comparable, suitable.

ἄπιστος.d: unbelieving, incredulous, unchristian; sometimes subst: unbeliever.

ἄρρητος.d: not to be uttered (because too sacred), secret, unspeakable, unspoken.

ἄρτι.d: now, just now, at this moment.

ἄρχων.d: a ruler, governor, leader, leading man; with the Jews, an official member (a member of the executive) of the assembly of elders.

ἄσπονδος.d: implacable, "not to be bound by truce".

ἄτακτος.d: (lit: out of order), disorderly, slack (in performance of duty).

ἄτομος.g: an indivisible part of time, a moment
ἄτομος.d: (lit: that cannot be cut), an indivisible part of time, a moment.

ἄτοπος.d: (lit: out of place, unusual, unbecoming), improper, unrighteous, perverse.

ἄφεσις.d: a sending away, a letting go, a release, pardon, complete forgiveness.

ἄχρι.g: as far as, up to, until
ἄχρι.d: as far as, up to, until, during.

ἅγιος.d: set apart by (or for) God, holy, sacred.

ἅλλομαι.d: I leap, leap up; of water: I spring up, bubble up.

ἅμα.g: at the same time, along with
ἅμα.d: at the same time, therewith, along with, together with.

ἅρπαξ.g: rapacious, ravenous, a robber, an extortioner
ἅρπαξ.d: rapacious, ravenous; a robber, an extortioner.

ἆρα.g: a particle asking a question, expecting a negative response
ἆρα.d: a particle asking a question, to which a negative answer is expected.

Ἀαρών.d: Aaron, son of Amram and Jochebed, brother of Moses.

Ἀβαδδών.d: Abaddon, Destroyer (i.e. Destroying Angel) or "place of destruction" (personified).

Ἀβιά.d: Abijah, (a) a king, son of Rehoboam, (b) founder of the eighth class of priests.

Ἀβιαθάρ.d: Abiathar, a priest in King David's time.

Ἀβιληνή.d: the Abilenian territory, the territory of Abila (in Syria), a small principality in the mountains of Damascus.

Ἀβιούδ.d: Abiud, son of Zerubbabel and father of Eliakim.

Ἀβραάμ.d: Abraham, progenitor of the Hebrew race.

Ἀδάμ.d: Adam, the first man, the first parent of the human race.

Ἀδδί.d: Addi, son of Cosam, and father of Melchi, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

Ἀδρίας.d: the Hadria, a name given by sailors not merely to the Adriatic Sea, to which it properly belonged, but also to the open Mediterranean to the south-east of Italy, to the sea that lay between Malta, Italy, Greece, and Crete.

Ἀδραμυττηνός.d: belonging to Adramyttium, a port in Mysia, in Asia Minor.

Ἀζώρ.d: Azor, son of Eliakim and father of Zadok, an ancestor of Jesus.

Ἀθῆναι.d: Athens, the intellectual capital of Greece.

Ἀκύλας.d: the Greek way of writing the Latin Aquila, a male proper name; the husband of Priscilla (Prisca), and a Jew, of a family belonging to (Sinope in ?) Pontus.

Ἀλέξανδρος.d: Alexander, a name of Greek origin, (a) son of Simon of Cyrene, (b) the High Priest's kinsman, (c) an Ephesian Jew, (d) the coppersmith.

Ἀλεξανδρεύς.d: an Alexandrian, a native (or resident) of Alexandria in Egypt.

Ἀλεξανδρῖνος.d: Alexandrian, belonging to Alexandria in Egypt.

Ἀμιναδάβ.d: Amminadab, son of Ram and father of Nahshon, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

Ἀμφίπολις.d: Amphipolis, a leading city of Macedonia.

Ἀμώς.d: Amos, son of Manasseh and father of Josiah, an ancestor of Jesus.

Ἀνδρέας.d: Andrew, brother of Simon Peter, and one of the apostles of Jesus, belonging to Bethsaida.

Ἀνδρόνικος.d: Andronicus, a member of the Roman church, and a kinsman or fellow-tribesman of Paul.

Ἀντιοχεύς.d: an Antiochian, an inhabitant of Antioch.

Ἀντιπατρίς.d: Antipatris, a town, where was a Roman colony, on the road between Caesarea and Jerusalem.

Ἀντιπᾶς.d: Antipas, a Christian martyr of Pergamum.

Ἀντιόχεια.d: Antioch, (a) Antioch on the river Orontes, capital of the Province Syria, (b) "Pisidian" Antioch, not in Pisidia, but near Pisidia, in the Roman Province Galatia.

Ἀπολλύων.d: Apollyon, The Destroying One, a Greek translation of the Hebrew: Abaddon.

Ἀπφία.d: Apphia, a Christian lady of Colossae, either wife or sister of Philemon.

Ἀράμ.d: Ram, son of Hezron and father of Amminadab.

Ἀρίσταρχος.d: Aristarchus, a Christian, belonging to Thessalonica in Macedonia.

Ἀραβία.d: Arabia, the district south of Palestine.

Ἀρεοπαγίτης.g: member of the Council of the Areopagus
Ἀρεοπαγίτης.d: member of the Council of the Areopagus, an Areopagite.

Ἀρφαξάδ.d: Arphaxad, son of Shem, and father of Cainan.

Ἀρχέλαος.d: Archelaus, Herod Archelaus, son and successor of Herod I, reigned over Judea from 4 B.C. to A.D. 6 and died before A.D. 18.

Ἀσήρ.d: Asher, one of the sons of Jacob, and founder of one of the Twelve Tribes.

Ἀσία.g: roughly the western third of Asia Minor
Ἀσία.d: the Roman province of Asia, roughly the western third of Asia Minor.

Ἀσιάρχης.d: an Asiarch, an official connected with the worship of Rome and the Emperor in the Roman province Asia.

Ἀσιανός.g: belonging to the Roman province Asia

Ἀττάλεια.d: Attalia, the port of Perga in Pamphylia.

Ἀχάζ.d: Ahaz, son of Jotham and father of Hezekiah.

Ἀχαΐα.d: the Roman Province Achaia, governed by a proconsul, and practically conterminous with modern Greece before 1912.

Ἁγάρ.d: Hagar, the servant of Sarah, concubine of Abraham.

Ἁλφαῖος.d: Alphaeus; apparently two persons, (a) father of Levi, and (b) father of James.

Ἁνανίας.d: Ananias, (a) husband of Sapphira, a member of the early church at Jerusalem, (b) a member of the church at Damascus, (c) the high priest at Jerusalem.

Ἁρέτας.d: Aretas IV, King of the Nabataeans.

Ἄζωτος.d: Azotus, Ashdod, a coast town of Palestine belonging to the ancient Philistia, and part of Herod's kingdom.

Ἄλφα.g: the first letter of the Greek alphabet
Ἄλφα.d: alpha; the first letter of the Greek alphabet.

Ἄρτεμις.d: Artemis, a goddess, worshipped principally at Ephesus, typifying fertility (she had no relation with the other Artemis, the maiden huntress, to whom corresponded the Latin Diana).

Ἅβελ.d: Abel, second son of Adam and Eve, brother of Cain.

Ἅννα.d: Anna, a prophetess, who visited the infant Jesus.

Ἆσσος.d: Assos, a port of Mysia, in the Roman province Asia.

ἐάω.d: I allow, permit, let alone, leave.

ἐγγίζω.d: trans: I bring near; intrans: I come near, approach.

ἐγείρω.d: (a) I wake, arouse, (b) I raise up.

ἐγκαίνια.d: a renewal, dedication; the feast of rededication.

ἐγκαλέω.g: I bring a charge against, accuse

ἐγκαταλείπω.d: I leave in the lurch, abandon (one who is in straits), desert.

ἐγκομβόομαι.d: I clothe myself (originally: I tie round in a knot).

ἐγκοπή.d: an incision, a cutting, break; met: an interruption, a hindrance.

ἐδαφίζω.d: I dash to the ground, level with the ground.

ἐθνάρχης.d: an ethnarch, tribal lord, a subordinate ruler.

ἐθνικός.g: pagan, heathen, gentile; a Gentile, non-Jew
ἐθνικός.d: pagan, heathen, gentile; subst: a Gentile, non-Jew.

ἐθνικῶς.d: in the manner of Gentiles, like the rest of the world.

ἐκ.g: from out, out from among, from
ἐκ.d: from out, out from among, from, suggesting from the interior outwards.

ἐκβάλλω.g: I throw, cast, put out, banish, bring forth, produce
ἐκβάλλω.d: I throw (cast, put) out; I banish; I bring forth, produce.

ἐκβολή.d: a throwing out, a jettisoning of cargo to lighten a ship.

ἐκδίδωμι.g: I give out, let, let out for my own advantage
ἐκδίδωμι.d: I give out, let; middle: I let out for my own advantage.

ἐκδίκησις.d: (a) a defense, avenging, vindication, vengeance, (b) full (complete) punishment.

ἐκδικέω.g: I give justice over, defend, avenge, vindicate

ἐκδιώκω.d: I persecute, expel by persecuting, drive out, vex, harass.

ἐκδύω.g: I put off, take off, strip off
ἐκδύω.d: I put off, take off, strip off, with acc. of person or garment or both.

ἐκεῖ.d: (a) there, yonder, in that place, (b) thither, there.

ἐκζητέω.d: I seek out, seek out after, require.

ἐκθαμβέομαι.d: I am greatly astonished, am awe-struck.

ἐκκλίνω.g: I fall away from, turn away
ἐκκλίνω.d: (lit: I bend away from), I fall away from, turn away (from), deviate.

ἐκκλησία.d: an assembly, congregation, church; the Church, the whole body of Christian believers.

ἐκκομίζω.d: I carry out (of the city gate for burial).

ἐκκόπτω.d: I cut out (off, away), remove, prevent.

ἐκλέγομαι.d: I pick out for myself, choose, elect, select.

ἐκλείπω.d: I fail, die out, come to an end, am defunct.

ἐκλεκτός.d: chosen out, elect, choice, select, sometimes as subst: of those chosen out by God for the rendering of special service to Him (of the Hebrew race, particular Hebrews, the Messiah, and the Christians).

ἐκλογή.g: a choosing out, selecting, choice by God
ἐκλογή.d: a choosing out, selecting, choice (by God).

ἐκλύομαι.g: I am unstrung, become weak, fail
ἐκλύομαι.d: I loose, release, unloose (as a bow-string), relax, enfeeble; pass: I am faint, grow weary.

ἐκμυκτηρίζω.g: I deride, scoff at, mock greatly

ἐκνήφω.g: I return to soberness of mind

ἐκνεύω.d: I escape, get clear of, deviate, withdraw.

ἐκπίπτω.g: I fall out, fall off, fall away, fade away, wither away
ἐκπίπτω.d: I fall out, fall off, fall away; hence in nautical language: I fall off from the straight course; of flowers: I fade away, wither away; I fall from, lose, forfeit; I am cast ashore; I am fruitless.

ἐκπειράζω.g: I put to the test, make trial of, tempt
ἐκπειράζω.d: I put to the test, make trial of, tempt, try.

ἐκπλέω.d: I sail out (of harbor), sail away.

ἐκπλήσσομαι.d: I strike with panic or shock; I amaze, astonish.

ἐκπληρόω.g: I fill completely, fulfill in every particular
ἐκπληρόω.d: I fill completely, fulfill in every particular (to the utmost), make good.

ἐκπνέω.d: (lit: I breathe out), I breathe my last, expire.

ἐκπορεύομαι.d: I depart from; I am voided, cast out; I proceed from, am spoken; I burst forth, flow out, am spread abroad.

ἐκπτύω.g: I spit upon, disdain, reject, loathe
ἐκπτύω.d: I spit out, disdain, reject, loathe.

ἐκριζόω.d: I root out, pluck up by the roots.

ἐκστρέφομαι.g: I change for the worse, corrupt, pervert

ἐκτίθημι.g: I put out or expose a child, set forth, explain
ἐκτίθημι.d: (a) I put out or expose a child, (b) mid: I set forth, expound, explain.

ἐκτείνω.d: I stretch out (forth), cast forth (as of an anchor), lay hands on.

ἐκτελέω.d: I complete, bring to completion, carry out, perform.

ἐκτενής.d: intent, constant, strenuous, intense; met: earnest, zealous.

ἐκτινάσσω.d: I shake off; mid: I shake off from myself.

ἐκτρέπομαι.d: (lit: I turn out from); mid. and pass: I turn aside (from the right road), wander, forsake, and with an object: I remove from myself, shun, avoid.

ἐκτός.g: without, outside, except, the outside, apart from
ἐκτός.d: (a) adv: (1) without, outside, beyond, (2) except, (3) subst: the outside, (b) prep: outside, apart from.

ἐκφέρω.d: I bring out, carry out, sometimes out of the city for burial; I bring forth, bear, produce.

ἐκφεύγω.g: I flee out, away, I escape
ἐκφεύγω.d: I flee out, away, escape; with an acc: I escape something.

ἐκφύω.g: I put forth, cause to sprout

ἐκχέω.d: I pour out (liquid or solid); I shed, bestow liberally.

ἐκχωρέω.d: I go out, depart from, withdraw, flee.

ἐκψύχω.g: I breathe my last, die, expire

ἐλάχιστος.d: least, smallest, but perhaps oftener in the weaker sense: very little, very small.

ἐλέγχω.d: (a) I reprove, rebuke, discipline, (b) I expose, show to be guilty.

ἐλαία.d: an olive tree; the Mount of Olives.

ἐλαύνω.d: (a) trans: I drive (on), propel, (b) intrans: I row.

ἐλεημοσύνη.d: abstr: alms-giving, charity; concr: alms, charity.

ἐλευθερία.d: freedom, liberty, especially: a state of freedom from slavery.

ἐλλογέω.g: I charge to, put to one's account
ἐλλογέω.d: I charge to, put to one's account, impute.

ἐλπίζω.d: I hope, hope for, expect, trust.

ἐμβαίνω.d: I step in; I go onboard a ship, embark.

ἐμβατεύω.d: I enter, set foot on, intrude, pry into.

ἐμβιβάζω.d: trans: I embark, put on board, step into.

ἐμβλέπω.d: I look into (upon); met: I consider; I see clearly.

ἐμβριμάομαι.d: I snort (with the notion of coercion springing out of displeasure, anger, indignation, antagonism), express indignant displeasure with some one; I charge sternly.

ἐμμένω.g: I remain or abide in, abide by, maintain
ἐμμένω.d: I remain (abide) in, abide by, maintain, persevere in.

ἐμπίπτω.g: I fall in, am cast in
ἐμπίπτω.d: I fall in, am cast in, am involved in.

ἐμπεριπατέω.g: I walk about in a place
ἐμπεριπατέω.d: I walk about in a place, live among, am conversant with.

ἐμπλέκομαι.d: I enfold, entangle; pass: I am involved in.

ἐμπορεύομαι.g: I travel as a merchant, engage in trade
ἐμπορεύομαι.d: I travel as a merchant, engage in trade; I traffic in, make gain or business of.

ἐμπόριον.d: a place of traffic, mart, market, market-house.

ἐμφανίζω.g: I make visible, report against, appear before
ἐμφανίζω.d: I make visible (manifest); hence: I report (inform) against; pass: I appear before.

ἐνάρχομαι.d: I begin (in), make a beginning, commence.

ἐνέργεια.d: working, action, productive work, activity; in the NT, confined to superhuman activity.

ἐνέχω.d: (a) I have a grudge against, am angry (with), (b) pass. or mid: I am entangled, entangle myself.

ἐνίστημι.g: I place in or upon, am at hand, am present, threaten
ἐνίστημι.d: I place in or upon; only in the intrans. tenses: I impend, am at hand, am present, threaten; as adj: present.

ἐναντίον.g: before, in the presence of, in the eyes of

ἐνδημέω.d: I am at home, live in a place.

ἐνδιδύσκω.d: (somewhat rare) (of clothing: I put on another); mid: I put on (myself).

ἐνδοξάζομαι.d: I glorify, acknowledge the glory belonging to, recognize as glorious; pass: I am glorified in.

ἐνδυναμόω.d: I fill with power, strengthen, make strong.

ἐνδύνω.d: I clothe; mid: I enter, creep into.

ἐνεδρεύω.g: I lie in wait for, seek to entrap, defraud, deceive
ἐνεδρεύω.d: I lie in wait (ambush) for, seek to entrap (hence: I defraud, deceive).

ἐνειλέω.g: I wrap up, roll up in something
ἐνειλέω.d: I wrap up, roll up in (something), wind in.

ἐνεργέω.d: I work, am operative, am at work, am made to work, accomplish; mid: I work, display activity.

ἐνεργής.d: effective, productive of due result, at work.

ἐνθυμέομαι.d: I meditate upon, reflect upon, ponder.

ἐννεύω.g: I make a sign to by nodding

ἐνοικέω.g: I dwell in, am settled in
ἐνοικέω.d: I dwell in, am settled (stationary) in; met: I am indwelling.

ἐνοχλέω.d: I disturb, cause tumult, trouble, annoy.

ἐνταφιασμός.g: embalming, preparation of a body for burial

ἐντεῦθεν.g: hence, from this place, on this side and on that

ἐντρέπω.g: I turn to confusion, put to shame, reverence
ἐντρέπω.d: (a) I turn to confusion, put to shame, (b) mid: I reverence, regard.

ἐντρέφομαι.g: I nourish on, am educated in
ἐντρέφομαι.d: I nourish (sustain) on, am educated in.

ἐντυγχάνω.g: I meet, encounter, call upon, make a petition
ἐντυγχάνω.d: (a) I meet, encounter, hence: (b) I call (upon), make a petition, make suit, supplication.

ἐντυλίσσω.g: I wrap up, roll round, envelop

ἐντόπιος.g: belonging to the place, native, resident
ἐντόπιος.d: belonging to the place, native, resident; subst: a citizen.

ἐνυβρίζω.d: I insult, outrage, treat contemptuously, mock at.

ἐνυπνιάζομαι.d: I dream (see visions) in my sleep.

ἐνωτίζομαι.g: I take into my ear, listen to
ἐνωτίζομαι.d: I take into my ear, give ear to, listen to.

ἐνώπιον.g: before the face of, in the presence of
ἐνώπιον.d: before the face of, in the presence of, in the eyes of.

ἐξάγω.d: I lead out, sometimes to death, execution.

ἐξέλκω.d: (lit: I draw out of the right place, or I draw aside out of the right way), I entice.

ἐξίστημι.d: (lit: I remove from a standing position), (a) in trans. tenses: I astonish, amaze, (b) in intrans. tenses: I am astonished, amazed; I am out of my mind, am mad.

ἐξαγοράζω.d: I buy out, buy away from, ransom; mid: I purchase out, buy, redeem, choose.

ἐξαιρέω.d: I take out, remove; sometimes (mid): I choose, sometimes: I rescue.

ἐξαιτέομαι.d: I demand of, ask for, beg earnestly for.

ἐξαλείφω.d: I plaster, wash over; I wipe off, wipe out, obliterate.

ἐξανάστασις.d: a rising up and out, resurrection.

ἐξανίστημι.d: (a) in trans. tenses: I raise up, cause to grow, (b) in intrans. tenses: I rise up from.

ἐξανατέλλω.d: I rise (spring) up out (of the ground).

ἐξαπορέομαι.g: I am utterly without resource, am in despair

ἐξαποστέλλω.d: I send away, send forth (a person qualified for a task).

ἐξαρτίζω.d: (a) I fit up, completely furnish, equip, furnish, supply, (b) I accomplish, finish.

ἐξαστράπτω.d: I flash forth like lightning, gleam, am radiant.

ἐξετάζω.d: I examine, question, inquire at, search out.

ἐξηγέομαι.d: I lead, show the way; met: I unfold, narrate, declare.

ἐξηχέομαι.d: I sound out (forth) (referring either to the clearness or to the loudness of the sound).

ἐξισχύω.g: I have strength for, am perfectly able
ἐξισχύω.d: I have strength for (a difficult task), am perfectly able.

ἐξομολογέω.d: (a) I consent fully, agree out and out, (b) I confess, admit, acknowledge (cf. the early Hellenistic sense of the middle: I acknowledge a debt), (c) I give thanks, praise.

ἐξορκίζω.d: I adjure, put to oath; I exorcise.

ἐξορκιστής.d: an exorcist, a caster out of evil spirits by the use of names or spells.

ἐξορύσσω.d: (a) I dig out, hence: I open up, (b) I gouge.

ἐξουθενέω.d: I set at naught, ignore, despise.

ἐξουσία.d: (a) power, authority, weight, especially: moral authority, influence, (b) in a quasi-personal sense, derived from later Judaism, of a spiritual power, and hence of an earthly power.

ἐξουσιάζω.d: I exercise (wield) power (authority), pass: I am ruled, am held under authority.

ἐξωθέω.d: I drive out, expel, propel, thrust out; I drive out of the sea, drive on shore.

ἐπάγω.d: I bring upon; met: I cause to be imputed to.

ἐπάνω.g: on the top, above, superior to
ἐπάνω.d: (a) adv: on the top, above, (b) prep: on the top of, above, over, on, above, more than, superior to.

ἐπέρχομαι.d: I come to, arrive, come on, come upon, attack.

ἐπέχω.g: I hold forth, pay attention, note, delay
ἐπέχω.d: (a) trans: I hold forth, (b) intrans: I mark, pay attention (heed), note; I delay, stay, wait.

ἐπί.g: on, to, against, on the basis of, at

ἐπίγειος.d: (a) on the earth, belonging to the earth (as opposed to the sky), (b) in a spiritual sense, belonging to the earthly sphere, earthly (as opposed to heavenly).

ἐπίγνωσις.d: knowledge of a particular point (directed towards a particular object); perception, discernment, recognition, intuition.

ἐπίθεσις.d: a laying on; an attack, assault.

ἐπίκειμαι.d: (a) dat: I am placed upon, am laid upon, lie upon, am imposed; I press upon, (b) absol: I press hard, am insistent, insist.

ἐπίλοιπος.d: remaining, that is left over, still left.

ἐπίσκοπος.d: (used as an official title in civil life), overseer, supervisor, ruler, especially used with reference to the supervising function exercised by an elder or presbyter of a church or congregation.

ἐπίτροπος.d: (a) (procurator) a steward, (b) (tutor) a guardian (appointed for an "infant" [under 14 perhaps] by the father or by a magistrate).

ἐπαθροίζομαι.g: I gather together, crowd upon, press around
ἐπαθροίζομαι.d: I gather together, pass: I crowd upon (some one), press around.

ἐπαισχύνομαι.d: I am ashamed, am ashamed of.

ἐπαιτέω.d: I beg, am a beggar, ask alms.

ἐπακολουθέω.d: I follow close after, accompany, dog; I imitate, pursue, am studious of.

ἐπακροάομαι.d: I listen to, hear, hearken to.

ἐπανάγω.d: (a) nautical: I put out (from the shore), (lit: I take up a ship on to the high seas), (b) I go up, possibly: I go up again, return.

ἐπανίσταμαι.d: intrans. tenses: I rise up against.

ἐπαναμιμνῄσκω.d: I remind, possibly: I remind again.

ἐπαναπαύομαι.g: I rest upon, rely on, trust in

ἐπαρκέω.g: I aid, relieve, do service, render help
ἐπαρκέω.d: I aid, relieve, do service, render help, am strong enough for.

ἐπαφρίζω.d: I foam out (a metaphor from the seaweed and refuse borne on the crest of waves), vomit forth.

ἐπεί.d: of time: when, after; of cause: since, because; otherwise: else.

ἐπειδή.d: of time: when, now, after that; of cause: seeing that, forasmuch as.

ἐπεισαγωγή.d: bringing in (besides or in addition), introduction, importation.

ἐπενδύομαι.d: I have on over (as a garment); mid: I put on myself in addition.

ἐπενδύτης.d: a coat, outer wrap or tunic.

ἐπερώτημα.d: inquiry, request, appeal, demand; a profession, pledge.

ἐπηρεάζω.d: I insult, treat wrongfully, molest, revile.

ἐπιβάλλω.g: I throw upon, lay, strike upon
ἐπιβάλλω.d: (a) I throw upon, cast over, (b) I place upon, (c) I lay, (d) intrans: I strike upon, rush.

ἐπιβαίνω.d: (a) I set foot on, step on, (b) I mount (a horse), board (a vessel).

ἐπιβαρέω.d: I put a burden on, am burdensome.

ἐπιβλέπω.d: I look with favor on, regard.

ἐπιγίνομαι.d: I arise, spring up, arrive, come on.

ἐπιγαμβρεύω.g: I marry a deceased brother's wife
ἐπιγαμβρεύω.d: I take to wife after, marry a deceased brother's wife.

ἐπιγινώσκω.g: I come to know, discern, recognize
ἐπιγινώσκω.d: I come to know by directing my attention to him or it, I perceive, discern, recognize; aor: I found out.

ἐπιγράφω.d: I write upon, inscribe, imprint a mark on.

ἐπιδίδωμι.g: I hand in, give up, give way
ἐπιδίδωμι.d: (a) trans: I hand in, give up, (b) intrans: I give way (to the wind).

ἐπιδείκνυμι.d: I show, display, point out, indicate; I prove, demonstrate.

ἐπιδημέω.d: I sojourn, am resident (temporarily, in a foreign city).

ἐπιδιατάσσομαι.d: I make an additional testamentary disposition, I furnish with additions.

ἐπιδιορθόω.d: I set in order besides, put in order, correct.

ἐπιδύω.d: I sink, set, set during, go down.

ἐπιεικής.d: gentle, mild, forbearing, fair, reasonable, moderate.

ἐπιζητέω.g: I seek after, desire, search for
ἐπιζητέω.d: I seek after, desire, search for, make inquiries about.

ἐπιθανάτιος.g: at the point of death, condemned to death

ἐπιθυμέω.g: I long for, covet, lust after
ἐπιθυμέω.d: I long for, covet, lust after, set the heart upon.

ἐπιθυμία.g: desire, eagerness for, inordinate desire, lust

ἐπικαθίζω.d: I sit upon, cause to sit upon.

ἐπικαλέω.g: I call by an additional name, appeal to
ἐπικαλέω.d: (a) I call (name) by a supplementary (additional, alternative) name, (b) mid: I call upon, appeal to, address.

ἐπικαλύπτω.d: I put a cover on, cover up.

ἐπικατάρατος.d: on whom a curse has been invoked, accursed, doomed to destruction.

ἐπιλέγω.g: I call, choose for myself, am named
ἐπιλέγω.d: I call; mid: I choose for myself; pass: I am named.

ἐπιλαμβάνομαι.d: I lay hold of, take hold of, seize (sometimes with beneficent, sometimes with hostile, intent).

ἐπιλύω.d: I loose, release; I solve, settle, explain, interpret, decide.

ἐπιμένω.d: (a) I remain, tarry, (b) I remain in, persist in.

ἐπιμαρτυρέω.d: I testify earnestly, bear witness to.

ἐπιμελέομαι.g: I take care of, attend to

ἐπινεύω.d: I nod to, assent to, consent.

ἐπιπίπτω.d: I fall upon, press upon, light upon, come over.

ἐπιπλήσσω.d: I rebuke, chide, reprove, strike at.

ἐπιποθέω.d: I long for, strain after, desire greatly, have affection for.

ἐπισκηνόω.d: I raise a tent (over), dwell, spread a tabernacle over.

ἐπισκοπέω.d: I exercise oversight, care for, visit.

ἐπιστέλλω.d: I write, send by letter to.
